scientific_name.description: Its scientific name, e.g. 'Quercus robur', or 'Mentha × piperita' for a hybrid.

slug.description: Its slug, e.g. quercus-robur: the surest way to name it to another Trefle step.

status.description: 'accepted' for a name in use; null when Trefle has none.

synonyms.description: Other scientific names it has been published under.

year.description: The year its name was first validly published, or null.

total.description: How many plants match, over all pages.

search_species.description: Find species, subspecies, varieties, forms and hybrids by part of a name, best matches first. Like Search plants, but returns every taxon rather than one result per species, and can keep to chosen ranks.
search_species.name: search_species

parameters.description: What to look for: part of a species's common name in any language, its scientific name, or one of its synonyms. Best matches come first.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: Only these ranks: species, or the subspecies, varieties, forms and hybrids below them.
parameters.name: ranks

parameters.description: Only plants Trefle records as edible. Trefle records this for few plants, so turning it on leaves a short list; leave it off to include every plant.
parameters.name: edible_only

parameters.description: Only plants Trefle records as vegetables.
parameters.name: vegetables_only

parameters.description: Only plants with any of these parts recorded as edible.
parameters.name: edible_parts

parameters.description: Only plants whose flowers are recorded in any of these colours.
parameters.name: flower_colors

parameters.description: Only plants recorded as flowering in any of these months.
parameters.name: bloom_months

parameters.description: Only plants with any of these life cycles. Trefle records a life cycle for very few plants so far.
parameters.name: durations

parameters.description: Only plants of any of these forms, as the USDA classes them. The way to find trees or shrubs: Trefle has this for far more plants than their height or woodiness.
parameters.name: growth_habits

parameters.description: Leave out plants Trefle has no picture of.
parameters.name: only_with_image

parameters.description: Leave out plants with no common name in English, which is most of them: many are known by their scientific name alone.
parameters.name: only_with_common_name

parameters.description: How many results to return at once, from 1 to 100. Leave empty for 20.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Which page of results to return, starting at 1, each as long as Results per page. Leave empty for the first page. A page past the last one comes back empty but still gives the total.
parameters.name: page

last_page.description: The last page's number. Trefle serves at most 2,500 pages of any list.

next_page.description: The next page's number, or null on the last page Trefle serves: the value to loop on.

author.description: Who first published its name, e.g. 'L.', or null.

bibliography.description: Where its name was first published, or null.

common_name.description: Its usual common name in English, or null: most plants have none.

complete_data.description: Whether Trefle counts its record as complete. Hardly any are.

completion_ratio.description: How much of its trait data Trefle has, as a percentage, or null.

family_common_name.description: Its family's common name, or null.

genus_id.description: Its genus' id, which Get a genus takes.

id.description: The species' id, which Get a species takes. Get a plant takes it too, and finds the plant it belongs to.

image_url.description: A link to its main picture, or null.

links.description: Its related records, each a path under trefle.io, which every Trefle step takes as it is.

rank.description: Its rank: species, ssp (subspecies), var (variety), form, hybrid or subvar (subvariety).

scientific_name.description: Its scientific name, e.g. 'Quercus robur', or 'Mentha × piperita' for a hybrid.

slug.description: Its slug, e.g. quercus-robur: the surest way to name it to another Trefle step.

status.description: 'accepted' for a name in use; null when Trefle has none.

synonyms.description: Other scientific names it has been published under.

year.description: The year its name was first validly published, or null.

total.description: How many species match, over all pages.

description: Look up plants in Trefle, an open botanical database of the world's plants: search by common or scientific name, get a plant's classification, edible parts, flower colours, bloom months, growth habit, soil and light needs, pictures and native range, list the plants native to or introduced in a country or state, filter by trait, and see which source each value came from. Needs a free Trefle access token.
